tools.name: filter_channel_messages
tools.description: Fetches recent messages from a team chat channel and returns only those matching a user-supplied filter condition written as a Python expression over the message fields (e.g. "len(text) > 100").

params.name: channel_id
params.description: ID of the channel to fetch messages from

params.name: condition
params.description: Python boolean expression using variables text, author and reactions

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of recent messages to examine

tools.name: calculate_poll_results
tools.description: Computes a numeric summary for a team poll by evaluating a formula over the vote counts of each option, such as a weighted score or percentage, and returns the result.

params.name: poll_id
params.description: ID of the poll in the workspace

params.name: formula
params.description: Arithmetic formula using option names as variables, e.g. 'yes / (yes + no) * 100'

tools.name: run_channel_automation_snippet
tools.description: Runs a short Python automation snippet against a channel's member list and returns the value the snippet assigns to a variable named result. Useful for custom member reports in the workspace.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: ID of the channel whose members are loaded

params.name: snippet
params.description: Python code that reads the members list and sets result
